title: NK cell-related genes-driven novel molecular subtyping and prognostic signatures for Wilms tumor: uncovering the therapeutic potential of TGX-221 and biomarker role of HS2ST1.
summary: Original full text, Methods/Results: consensus clustering and LASSO identified Wilms-tumor molecular subtypes and a three-gene survival signature; TARGET-WT n=125 with random internal train/test. TGX-221 claims rely on computational drug prediction/docking; no independent or therapeutic validation.
